scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Lemony Cucumbers: cucumber, white wine vinegar, onion, white sugar, lemon juice, celery seed, salt, black pepper.
Step 1 of Lemony Cucumbers: Toss cucumbers, vinegar, chopped onion, sugar, lemon juice, celery seeds, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until combined; cover. Chill in the refrigerator, 4 hours..
